About this edition

Your City Council is an independent prototype covering three Toronto historical decisions from 2024. It is not affiliated with the City of Toronto.

Sources reviewed November 12, 2026. Historical summaries are curated and do not update automatically. Dataset information is requested from Toronto Open Data when you open a category. Summaries describe the recorded decisions, not a complete statement of current policy.

Saved stories stay in this browser. No account is required.
